categories.desc: About pace: go gently, don't rush, don't overdo it.
cards: Vas-y doucement.
Take it easy. / Go gently.
Slow down, be careful: with a task, a person, or food and drink. Formal or plural: allez-y doucement.
Vas-y doucement avec le vin, tu conduis.
Go easy on the wine, you're driving.
Vas-y mollo.
Easy does it.
Very casual version of vas-y doucement. Mollo comes from mou (soft).
Vas-y mollo sur le sel, c'est déjà assez salé.
Easy on the salt, it's salty enough already.
Doucement, doucement…
Easy, easy now…
Soothing, said slowly to a nervous person, a child or an animal. Also a warning: doucement ! (careful!)
Doucement, doucement… voilà, il ne va pas te mordre.
Easy, easy now… there you go, he won't bite you.
Je vais y aller doucement.
I'll take it slowly.
About yourself: after an illness, a long break, or before a big meal. Also je vais faire doucement.
Je reprends le sport, mais je vais y aller doucement.
I'm getting back into sport, but I'll take it slowly.
Pas si vite !
Not so fast!
Stops someone rushing ahead, in action or in reasoning.
Pas si vite ! On n'a pas encore signé le contrat.
Not so fast! We haven't signed the contract yet.
Prends ton temps.
Take your time.
Reassures someone that there's no hurry. Formal: prenez votre temps. Also rien ne presse (there's no rush).
Prends ton temps, on n'est pas pressés.
Take your time, we're not in a hurry.

categories.desc: About state: rest, keep still, have a quiet time.
cards: Reste tranquille.
Keep still. / Behave.
To a child: stop fidgeting, settle down. To an adult: don't worry about it, stay out of it.
Reste tranquille deux minutes, je finis de t'habiller.
Keep still for two minutes, I'm nearly done dressing you.
Repose-toi bien.
Get some good rest.
A kind goodbye to someone tired or ill. Formal: reposez-vous bien.
Rentre chez toi et repose-toi bien. On se voit lundi.
Go home and get some good rest. See you on Monday.
Je vais rester tranquille.
I'm going to have a quiet one.
No plans, no going out. Also je vais me poser (I'm going to chill).
Ce week-end, je vais rester tranquille à la maison.
This weekend I'm going to have a quiet one at home.
Je me pose cinq minutes.
I'm sitting down for five minutes.
Se poser: to sit down and relax, to land. Casual and very common.
Je me pose cinq minutes et après je fais la vaisselle.
I'll sit down for five minutes and then do the washing-up.

categories.desc: About feelings: getting someone, or yourself, to cool down.
cards: Calme-toi.
Calm down.
Can backfire, just like in English. Formal or plural: calmez-vous. Softer and good for a group: du calme.
Calme-toi, on va trouver une solution.
Calm down, we'll find a solution.
Calmos !
Chill!
Slangy and playful, from calme. Rhyming joke version: relax, Max !
Calmos, les gars, c'est qu'un match de foot !
Chill, guys, it's only a football match!
On se calme !
Let's all calm down!
On used for tu or vous: a firm, slightly ironic call to order, from parents, teachers or referees.
Ho, ho, on se calme ! Pas besoin de crier.
Whoa, whoa, let's all calm down! No need to shout.
Ne t'énerve pas.
Don't get worked up.
S'énerver: to get annoyed or worked up. Spoken: t'énerve pas !
Ne t'énerve pas, il a dit ça pour rire.
Don't get worked up, he was only joking.
Il faut que je me calme.
I need to calm down.
About yourself, often before you say something you'll regret. Spoken: faut que je me calme.
Attends, il faut que je me calme avant de lui répondre.
Hang on, I need to calm down before I answer him.
